q: Let the AFK pool hold any number of players, with no 60-player cap?
w: A full pool punishes players; the IP rule stops alt farms.

q: Kick idle players after 20 minutes outside the AFK pool, but never inside it?
w: Frees slots for active players; the pool is the AFK place.

q: Ask pool players 'Still here?' with a button every 60 minutes?
c: Stops bots and alt farms.

q: Keep skill XP and set XP out of the AFK pool rewards?
w: Skills and sets reward active play.

q: Scale AFK pool money to the player's stage instead of a flat amount?
c: Tier 1 pays $310 per 15 minutes; tier 12 pays $1.07M.
w: Never useless late, never a money printer early.

q: Let AFK loot improve the longer a player stays, from 100% up to 180% at 6 hours?
c: Leaving the pool resets the session.

q: Give AFK pool keys at 1 h and 3 h (Ember), 6 h (Cinder) and 8 h (Blaze), once per day?
w: Rewards long sessions without beating active play.

q: Bank the AFK sell booster and start it when the player leaves the pool?
w: A booster used while AFK would be wasted.

q: Let up to 3 accounts per IP earn in the AFK pool, each with its own 8 hours?
c: Families on one connection share the 8 hours.
w: Same as the ratings rule (292); families are not punished.

q: Keep the daily AFK limit per IP saved across server restarts?
w: Otherwise a daily restart would reset the limit.

q: Count the 8-hour daily AFK limit per account, across all profiles?
w: Otherwise three profiles would allow 24 hours a day.

q: Skip an /afkpool command, showing pool status in the action bar, scoreboard and /menu?
w: The pool is a place; menus cover Bedrock (P5).

q: Stop staff on duty and vanished staff from earning in the AFK pool?
w: Staff powers must not earn rewards.

q: Show an [AFK] tag in the tab list only?
w: Chat stays clean.

q: Show the AFK reward chat line only for keys and boosters?
w: Small payouts go to the action bar, no spam.

q: Should finishing the tutorial once unlock everything on the player's later profiles too?
w: No busywork repeating it; /tutorial can replay it.

q: Should a new player who gets an island invite skip the portal and do the tutorial there?

q: Should the tutorial have no skip button, staying under 3 minutes?
w: Permissions unlock per step, so skipping would bypass alt protection.

q: Should deleting a profile also delete its /box items, like its auction listings?
w: Deleting removes everything on the profile (#118); today the box blocks deleting.

q: Remove the 3 island joins per season limit, since leaving an island already wipes that profile's progress?
w: No limits without real abuse (P1); leaving already costs everything (141).

q: Let island size grow past 9x9 up to 15x15, only through gems or the Black Market?

q: Keep items in /box until the season reset, never expiring?
w: Nothing lost by accident (P3), same as the collection bin (563).

q: Keep trash bins at spawn for everyone, now that /trash is for owner and admins only?
w: Players can still throw away junk without a command (O9, 376).

q: Check Mojang's usage guidelines before the store opens, and set rank progress perks to 0 if they forbid them?
w: Paid gameplay perks and paid keys can break the guidelines; looks and convenience stay either way.

q: Name the 7 donor ranks Hatchling, Fledgling, Firewing, Flamecrest, Sunfeather, Pyrelord, Immortal?
w: One phoenix story, fits the server, no clash with crate names.

q: Rename the free rank from Ember to Ashborn?
w: Every player rises from the ash; Ember stays a crate name only.

q: Donor prefixes in normal [Brackets], staff prefixes in BOLD CAPS?
w: A donor can never look like staff.

q: Move the Builder weight to 9, above all donor ranks?
w: Staff prefixes must always win over donor prefixes.

q: Bought ranks are account-wide, work on every profile and never expire?
w: Matches your answer 387 and the profile rules.
Small first step, clear jumps, a real top rank; set in Tebex, easy to change.

q: Won ranks give all perks of the donor tier they copy, sell and XP bonus included?
w: A prize should feel like a rank; the edge is small and lasts one season.

q: To get a won rank: 10 h played that season and 7 days on the winning island?
w: Stops carries by joining a top island at the last minute.

q: An admin approves the winners list before won ranks are given?
w: One check stops a wrong grant from a bug or exploit.

q: Show the won rank by default instead of the bought one (player can switch)?
w: A won rank is rarer and lasts only one season.

q: Three won ranks: Torchbearer (top 4-10), Flameheart (top 2-3 and board #1s), Firecrown (#1 islands)?
w: Enough winners to motivate, few enough to stay special.

q: An upgrade costs the new price minus the list price of your current rank?
w: Simple and fair, even if the old rank was bought on sale.

q: Top rank sell bonus +15% (steps 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15)?
w: Same value the balance sheet already uses, inside the +300% cap.

q: On a chargeback, remove the rank and flag the account for staff?
w: Standard store protection; staff see it at once.

q: Top rank skill XP bonus +10% (steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10)?
w: About half a skill level ahead; noticeable, not decisive.

q: Monthly low keys (Ember, Cinder, Blaze only) for ranks, claimable after 5 h played that month?
w: Keys stay earned by playing; the top rank gets about 2 days of AFK-pool keys.

q: Island fly from the 4th rank (Flamecrest) up?
w: Fly is a strong perk for the middle of the ladder; the Wings mastery gives it to everyone else.

q: Weekly rank kits per profile with bound items (food, blocks, island fuel)?
w: Bound items can never be sold, so no money enters the economy.

q: Ranks give no island or pillar XP boost?
w: One donor should not push a whole island ahead of others.

q: Free profile slot 2 at Firewing and slot 3 at Pyrelord (gems still unlock them too)?
w: Same places as the old Knight and Warlord on the longer ladder.

q: AH listing slots 6 for Ashborn up to 15 for Immortal?
w: More listings means more fees and tax, so it helps the money sinks.

q: /pv vaults 1 to 4 by rank, contents per profile?
w: Classic storage perk; per profile keeps profiles separate.

q: Ranks from Firewing up can join when the server is full?
w: Common donor perk that costs nothing in game.

q: Ashborn (free rank) gets +1 AH slot as its small perk?
w: A small, useful perk for everyone who claims the free rank.

q: Immortal does not include the premium battle pass?
w: Keeps rank power and pass progress apart, so the cap holds.

q: Rank kits and keys are claimed in /menu -> Rank rewards, with no new /kit command?
w: One click, works on Bedrock, no new command to learn.

q: Keep titles before the rank and tags after the name?
w: Already built and easy to read.

q: Give the existing achievement titles themed names like Magma Delver and Gold Phoenix (ids stay)?
w: Makes them fit the phoenix theme without losing anyone's titles.

q: Season winner titles carry the season number, like Firecrown S1?
w: The rank ends, the honor stays and stays unique.

q: Change the free tags to Spark, Smoke and Kindling (Ember stays a crate tag)?
w: Keeps the crate tag special.

q: The First Flame title for anyone with 1 h played in Season 1's first week?
w: Rewards launch players; 1 h stops join-and-leave alts.

q: The Eclipse crate gives one new tag every month that never comes back?
w: Gives the monthly crate a reason to open every month.

q: Every bought rank also gets its own rank tag, kept forever?
w: A lasting look for supporters that costs nothing in game.

q: Holiday tags can only be won in their month?
w: Makes them rare and worth showing.

q: Max 16 visible characters per title or tag?
w: Fits Bedrock chat and tab.

q: Personal and island achievements in one /achievements menu with Personal, Island and History tabs?
w: One place to look, works on Bedrock.

q: Boost points per tier 1, 2, 3, 5, 8?
w: Fast start, bigger rewards for the long tiers.

q: Personal achievements never boost sell or money directly?
w: Keeps the sell cap math of the balance sheet unchanged.

q: Achievement tiers give boosts and titles only, no crystals, money or keys?
w: Achievements should never print currency.

q: Personal boost caps: skill XP 10%, tool XP 10%, PvE damage 8%, rare finds 8%, crystals 6%, AH +2 slots?
w: Worth chasing, far below every family cap.

q: Island boost caps: production 8%, island crystals 6%, island XP 5%, fuel 10%?
w: About +3% income for a fully done island; fair and small.

q: Island achievement titles only for members who were on the island 3+ days?
w: Stops joining an island just to collect its titles.

q: All achievement progress and boosts reset each season, titles stay?
w: Matches your answer 354 and the season wipe.

q: Save a season summary of achievements in a History tab?
w: Players see what they did; cheap to store.

q: Same island achievement goals for solo and team islands, except Team Flame?
w: Simple; boosts are small and teams only compete with teams.

q: Core tutorial = 11 steps (portal, arrival, starter chest, first crop, menu, to the Depths, mine, sell, Forge, help NPC, bank), about 2 min 50 s?
w: Covers the whole money loop and stays under 3 minutes.

q: The core tutorial can't be skipped as a whole on the first run (staff can skip it for a player)?
w: It is short and it replaces the 30-minute limit as the anti-alt gate.

q: Tutorial once per account: finishing on one profile unlocks every profile?
w: Nobody should repeat it per profile; locks are about the account, not the island.

q: Locks open like this: team features after step 4, the Depths after step 5, auction house after step 8, /pay and /withdraw after step 11, /trade, warzone and new profiles at the finish?
w: Money-moving and PvP open last; everything harmless is open from the start.

q: Public chat and /msg are open from the start of the tutorial?
w: New players must be able to ask for help; the chat filter and mutes handle spam.

q: Players who joined before the tutorial existed count as finished (no locks, no reward)?
w: Testers and early players should not be locked out of features they already use.

q: Finish reward: $2,500 + 25 crystals + the title Firstflight, once per account, paid to the profile you finish on?
w: A clear reward without changing the economy (first hour earns about $50k).

q: Optional steps give 5 crystals each, once per account?
w: A small push to learn the rest of the server.

q: The guide is a small red parrot companion called Pip that only you can see?
w: Phoenix-like, never blocks the way, and parrots work on Bedrock; a player-shaped guide is the alternative.

q: Three short camera flyovers (spawn 6 s, island 6 s, Depths 5 s), skippable by sneaking?
w: Shows where to go like a real intro, but never wastes a player's time.

q: On Bedrock use Geyser's camera when available, otherwise short cut-and-fade shots?
w: Smooth where Bedrock supports it, and always works on every client.

q: New players walk the ~95 blocks from the spawn point to the Island portal (about 22 s) with a flame trail?
w: Their first walk shows the spawn; teleporting them would skip the first impression.

q: Ask the builder to change the copper floor line at spawn so it leads to the Island portal (it leads to the Forge now)?
w: The starter kit is now in the starter chest, so the first stop is the portal.

q: Starter chest = 5 starter tools, 8 wheat seeds, 8 bone meal, 2 oak saplings, 1 lava bucket, 16 bread, crafting table, chest, Field Guide book?
w: Every item has a job in the first hour of this server.

q: The 5 starter tools in the chest count as that profile's first starter kit claim (the 24 h timer starts)?
w: Stops getting two kits on day one; lost pieces still come back from the Forge.

q: No money note in the starter chest (every profile already starts with $1,000)?
w: Notes are tradeable value and would feed alt accounts.

q: Remove sugar cane, cactus, melon and pumpkin seeds and ice from the starter chest?
w: Those crops belong to later island tiers, and the pond already has infinite water.

q: A new player who joins a team gets a Starter pack (tools, book, bread) instead of a chest?
w: The team island already has the island items.

q: With a pending invite, the Island portal asks: create my own island or join that island?
w: Friends who invite a new player shouldn't lose them to an accidental solo island.

q: Rejoining mid-tutorial takes you straight back to your step after 2 s (sneak to stay at spawn)?
w: No walking back through the spawn to continue.

q: Steps done early count (for example opening /menu before the menu step)?
w: No busywork for players who explore.

q: Add the staff command /tutorial admin (status, skip, reset, step, stats)?
w: Support needs to fix a stuck player fast; it is a sub-command of the planned /tutorial.

q: Helpers can see tutorial status; only mods and up can skip or reset?
w: Skipping opens money features, so it belongs to mods.

q: Tutorial stats menu for mods and up (funnel, drop-off, time per step, Java vs Bedrock), events kept 180 days?
w: Shows which step loses players so you can fix it.

q: Watch again from /tutorial: no rewards, no locks change, quit any time?
w: Lets players and staff relearn without side effects.

q: After the tutorial, the first visit to a place offers its optional tour (with a Tips on/off toggle in /settings)?
w: Help shows up where it is needed instead of a long tutorial.

q: The Guide NPC at spawn opens the tutorial menu instead of the help menu?
w: The first NPC a new player sees should lead into the tutorial.

q: Staff never have tutorial locks, but can run the tutorial to test it?
w: Staff must reach every feature at once.

q: The mine step asks for 15 blocks in Mine Tier 1?
w: Enough to fill the satchel with something worth selling in about 30 s.

q: Settings and the shop are optional steps, not core steps?
w: Keeps the core under 3 minutes; both are one click from /menu and the finish screen points to them.

q: A new island on a 2nd or 3rd profile gets the starter chest and a 6 s welcome camera, but no tutorial?
w: The player already knows the game; the island is still new.

q: If Bedrock can't see text holograms or mannequins, use name tags and villagers for Bedrock viewers?
w: Every hint must be visible on both clients.
